title: The Walls That Keep Fingerprints

features.name: left wall
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that has learned to remember the shape of every hand that found it in the dark. You press your palm here and join a thousand others.

features.name: right wall
features.desc-on-touch: The opposite surface, equally scarred with contact. You trace the marks and find moments from decades apart, fingers crossing in the dark.

features.name: touch-gathering
features.desc-on-touch: Where all the contact collects. Every fingertip leaves a resonance here, a name spoken in pressure instead of sound.

features.name: trace archive
features.desc-on-touch: Written in oil and time, every contact maps itself here. The walls teach the darkness how to read.

features.name: casing antenna
features.desc-on-touch: A tree's memory held in copper, reaching upward from the stone floor. It broadcasts what the walls remember, the touch-frequency of everyone who came here seeking.

inscription: touch leaves behind what time cannot erase
